content: {"investigate": [{"tool": "logs", "service": "worker", "level": "ERROR", "contains": "payment-service", "why": "Check if workers are failing to call payment-service due to connection or timeout errors"}, {"tool": "sql", "query": "SELECT id, order_id, status, created_at FROM payments WHERE status = 'captured' AND order_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'confirmed')", "why": "Find specific payments violating I1_payment_has_order to see if they are recent and correlate with order creation spike"}], "hypotheses": [{"service": "payment-service", "kind": "bad_deploy", "mechanism": "Deploy v1.1 at t=576 introduced a fault causing payment captures to occur without confirming orders", "supporting": ["E1", "E8"], "refuting": ["E2", "E9"], "explains": ["I1_payment_has_order"], "repair_plan": [{"action": "rollback_service", "params": {"service": "payment-service"}}, {"action": "replay_payment_confirmations", "params": {}}]}, {"service": "order-service", "kind": "runtime_fault", "mechanism": "Order service is failing to confirm orders despite high creation rate, possibly due to database connection issues or internal state corruption", "supporting": ["E1", "E3"], "refuting": ["E9"], "explains": ["I1_payment_has_order"], "repair_plan": [{"action": "restart_service", "params": {"service": "order-service"}}, {"action": "replay_payment_confirmations", "params": {}}]}], "summary": "Two potential causes: payment-service bad deploy preventing order confirmations, or order-service runtime fault failing to confirm orders."}
